title: First Bath at Home
desc: Absolute chaos. Beautiful, soggy, hilarious chaos. You were not impressed. The bathroom was.
story: We had watched three YouTube videos, read two books, and still managed to forget to put a towel in reach before starting. You screamed like we were doing something terrible to you. The moment we wrapped you in your warm towel, you were immediately content. Lesson learned: have the towel ready.
